native.notAvailable: Not available — recorded guidance is used
native.deleteConfirm: Delete all household data from this iPhone?
native.deleteFooter: Removes the family, layout, saved places, plans and encryption key from this iPhone. Shared copies cannot be recalled.
native.translationNotice: Spanish and Vietnamese are draft translations awaiting language review.
native.privateStorage: Family details are encrypted on this iPhone. The key stays here; private data is excluded from device backups and cannot be restored on a new phone. Sharing or printing creates a copy outside DryRun.
native.publicBoundary: Supported public resources use only a public region identifier. Apple receives address searches and ordinary directions requests when you use those features.
native.prototype: Prototype: safety content and translations await expert review.
native.unlockDetail: Your encrypted family data can be opened after this device is unlocked. Nothing was deleted.
native.saveError: The saved data was kept. Your draft remains available; try saving again after the current operation finishes.
native.recovery: Your saved family data could not be opened
native.recoveryDetail: The encrypted file was kept. Retry after unlocking or updating the app. A missing key or damaged file needs recovery; starting over deletes it.
native.startOver: Start over and delete stored data
native.recoveryDelete: Delete unreadable data and start over?
native.localHelp: Official resources and alerts are not available for this location. Keep local emergency contacts in your family card.
native.removePersonNote: Their person-specific details and checks will be removed. Equipment stays recorded but becomes unassigned, and helpers must be chosen again where needed. Tap Save to apply this change.
native.removeEquipmentNote: This removes only this item and its preparation records. Family members, backup sources, contacts and places stay recorded. The change is saved when you confirm.
